text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey there. Nice Nature here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for number one... isn't really my style.
Well, as long as people are cheering for me, I guess I'll do my best."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, if I'm being greedy, I'd love to win, but... yeah.
...Let's just give it my best shot within what I can do!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
